events.title: Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
events.summary: Several semiconductor-related stocks, including Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation, experienced declines after surging crude oil prices and rising Treasury yields sparked inflation concerns and increased corporate borrowing costs. The market reaction was attributed to the U.S. military striking Iranian targets, leading to higher oil prices and a climb in the 10-year Treasury yield, which negatively impacts the cost of capital and profit margins in the chip supply chain. Despite the current dip, some of these stocks, like Teradyne, have shown significant gains year-to-date.

articles.headline: Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know

events.title: Prosperity Bancshares Submits Amended 8-K Detailing Financials for Stellar Bancorp Acquisition
events.summary: Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE:PB) filed an amended Form 8-K/A to include the financial statements of Stellar Bancorp, Inc. and pro forma financial data following their merger. The acquisition of Stellar Bancorp was finalized on July 1, 2026, with Stellar merging into Prosperity. The amendment provides audited financials for Stellar up to December 31, 2025, and unaudited interim financials as of March 31, 2026, along with pro forma statements reflecting the combined entity.

articles.headline: Prosperity Bancshares Submits Amended 8-K Detailing Financials for Stellar Bancorp Acquisition

events.title: Apollo to repackage $9 billion ONEOK stake into debt deal
events.summary: Apollo Global Management is reportedly seeking to repackage its $9 billion equity stake in ONEOK into investment-grade debt. This strategy allows ONEOK to fund its $4.4 billion acquisition of Brazos Midstream without taking on conventional debt or risking credit rating downgrades. Apollo aims to structure the deal to achieve investment-grade ratings, leveraging its Capital Solutions business and Athene's balance sheet, and has executed over $100 billion in similar transactions previously.

articles.headline: Apollo to repackage $9 billion ONEOK stake into debt deal

events.title: Stocks Fall on Rising Yields and Oil, With Apple the Lone Bright Spot
events.summary: On September 1, 2026, major stock indexes, including the Nasdaq Composite, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and S&P 500, experienced declines despite a 3% jump in Apple's stock. The market's downturn was primarily influenced by macroeconomic factors such as rising oil prices, intensifying conflict in Iran, and increasing 10-year Treasury yields, which hit 4.8%. Federal Reserve officials' hawkish remarks about potential rate hikes further fueled investor concerns, shifting focus to Friday's upcoming jobs report for market direction.

articles.headline: Stocks Fall on Rising Yields and Oil, With Apple the Lone Bright Spot

events.title: Avista seeks 11.5% natural gas rate cut in Washington state
events.summary: Avista Corp. has filed requests with the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission to reduce natural gas rates by approximately 11.5%, while electric rates would remain nearly unchanged. This reduction is primarily driven by an adjustment tied to Washington's Climate Commitment Act and lower wholesale natural gas prices. If approved, a typical residential natural gas customer would see a monthly bill decrease of about $7.38.

articles.headline: Avista seeks 11.5% natural gas rate cut in Washington state
